recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist 1970s composition featuring extreme scale shifts where giant platform-shod feet dominate the foreground, stepping over a miniature interior space with neon accents and a distant human figure.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of fashion elements with architectural interiors
Interaction between organic soft surfaces and rigid geometric neon lines
Warm golden-brown tones against vibrant pink and green neon
coreInvariants: High-heeled platform shoes as the primary structural element
Horizontal neon light tubes running along the back wall
A checkered or tiled floor pattern providing depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two massive legs and platform shoes occupy the left two-thirds of the frame in an extreme close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red and white platform heel in the center-left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal of the legs down to the shoes, then moves right along the neon lines to the small figure in the doorway.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides breathing room for the typography and the deep perspective of the room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and tan (shoes and floor)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep pink and magenta (neon and soft foreground fabric)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric green (neon tubes) and bright red (shoe straps)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon elements against a desaturated, hazy background atmosphere.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid modern digital gradients; use soft airbrush transitions
Limit to 1970s earth tones mixed with early disco neons

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating over the dark wall area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with weight or size variation for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like neon lines used as framing elements

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast elegance of the era
Matches the vertical stress and sharp serifs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of giant platform shoes in the foreground stepping over a miniature disco room with pink and green neon tubes on the wall and a small man standing in a distant doorway.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add title text in the top right corner using a golden yellow high-contrast serif font, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Check for extreme scale difference between shoes and man
Ensure neon tubes have a soft glow effect
Verify the airbrushed texture is consistent
Confirm typography is legible against the background

mustRedesign: Exact placement of the small figure to avoid direct copying
postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a physical airbrushed painting?
Is the scale of the shoes appropriately massive compared to the room?
Are the neon colors vibrant but integrated into the hazy atmosphere?
Is the typography clean and classically styled?
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Scale + Airbrush Texture + 1970s Disco Palette + High-Contrast Serif Typography
